- **Story:** As Morgan, I want the same source to give the same map bytes under any culture, so that a map made on one machine matches a map made on another.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a non-invariant culture with different string ordering (for example tr-TR and sv-SE), When the map is written, Then the bytes equal those written under the invariant culture
  2. Given the map writer, When it sorts, Then every sort uses an ordinal comparison (a test fails if one does not)
  3. Given docs/TRACEABILITY.md, When the card is merged, Then it names the test

## Context

- Small; the code already uses ordinal sorting and nothing proves it. Follow docs/CODING_GUIDELINES.md: one required test per criterion, shown failing first; the generated C# output stays identical (the recorded orders hash stays 409bf3c6...).
